text:
Ana (support): Heads up — ACME reported a 3x credits surge on their dashboard this morning, but their invoice shows normal usage. Customer is escalated and asking for root cause and timeline.
Ryan (engops): Thanks Ana. Can you paste the customer's org id and the approximate affected window?
Ana (support): org: org-acme-42, reported spike between 2026-03-08 02:00Z and 2026-03-09 14:00Z. They say token count on dashboard jumped ~2.7M tokens for a day.
Priya (billing-ops): I'm seeing a mismatch in daily aggregates vs ledger for that org. Dashboard shows the ingestion-derived metric, ledger shows final billed tokens. Looking at eventstore, there was a partial outage + replay on 2026-03-09.
Lee (sre): Replay started at 2026-03-09T03:20Z to catch up partition p-12 after consumer lag. I see a backfill job that re-processed ~150k events for that partition.
Julian (eng-ml): Possible double-counting if both the live ingestion and the replay wrote metering events without dedupe. Do we have idempotency keys on metering writes?
Ryan (engops): We do on the new pipeline but older backfill tool used raw event copies and set new event ids. Replay-bot: replay queued 149,832 events for p-12 (job id rb-8801).
Priya (billing-ops): Quick check: ledger shows +0.1% delta for most orgs but ACME shows +35% tokens on dashboard vs ledger aggregate during that window. I suspect dashboard pulled ingestion-stream metrics before dedupe/compaction finished.
Ana (support): Customer wants a repro and a path to fix/credit. They asked if this was caused by "replay" or their clients.
Julian (eng-ml): Repro steps for us: 1) find overlapping event ranges: run `replay-tool overlaps --job rb-8801 --check-dedup` 2) diff counts vs ledger by event id. Example: `psql -c "select count(*) from metering where org='org-acme-42' and ts between '2026-03-08' and '2026-03-09'"`
Lee (sre): Doing step 1 now. Quick log snippet from the replay controller: `INFO replay.rb: processed 149832 events, duplicates_detected=48216, write_mode=append`. That duplicates_detected is worrying — means we re-ingested events that already existed in the stream.
Ryan (engops): Immediate mitigation: pause dashboard aggregation refresh for ACME and mark the window as "reconciling" so the UI shows ledger numbers to the customer. I'll open a console flag.
Priya (billing-ops): For credits: we should compute the net delta after dedupe. If duplicates account for the +/- tokens, we can prepare a credit. I'll run a billing reconciliation job: `billing-recon --org org-acme-42 --from 2026-03-08 --to 2026-03-10 --mode dry-run` and share numbers in 1h.
Julian (eng-ml): Longer-term fix: require dedupe by event unique_id on replay tool and add pre-write check in the metering API. I can prioritize a patch to the replay-tool to run dedupe-pass before writes (cheap check against eventstore index).
Ana (support): Communicated to customer: we identified replay overlap, pausing dashboard deltas and running reconciliation. They want ETA on credits and a root-cause writeup.
Lee (sre): Action items: (1) Ryan pause dashboard refresh for org-acme-42 (in progress) (2) Priya run billing-recon and prepare provisional credit (3) Julian implement replay dedupe patch + smoke test (4) Ops compute final event delta and mark incident. Owning timelines: Ryan 15m, Priya 1h, Julian 48h.
Ryan (engops): Dashboard flag set: org-acme-42 aggregation paused. Notified customer via support note.
Priya (billing-ops): Billing-recon dry-run complete: duplicates account for ~2,730,412 tokens; ledger net delta is -43,210 tokens (rounding differences). I'll prepare a provisional credit of 2,730,412 tokens and schedule final adjustment after Julian's final dedupe confirmation.
Julian (eng-ml): I'll push a quick dedupe-prewrite in the replay worker and run unit + small-scale replay on a staging partition. Targeting PR by end of day.
Ana (support): Thanks team — I've sent the provisional credit note to the customer and told them we'll follow up with RCA and final numbers after engineering confirms.
replay-bot: rb-8801 status: dedupe-check queued (eta ~12m)
Lee (sre): Closing loop later: we'll create a post-incident ticket with timeline, root cause (replay write-mode append without event-id dedupe), and remediation (tool patch + dashboard compaction).
Ana (support): Marking this thread resolved for now. Will re-open if customer asks for more detail. :white_check_mark:
